high_level_description: The image shows a pair of black leather sandals displayed on a wooden shelf. The sandals have a thick sole with a textured pattern, likely for added grip and comfort. They feature two straps across the foot and a single strap around the ankle, secured with a small buckle. The brand name "Capachinos" is visible on the inner side of each sandal, along with a small red dot above the text. The sandals are neatly arranged, with one slightly overlapping the other. A price tag is attached to the left sandal, indicating that it is for sale.
